name: Cobra Scale Armor
body:
Aura: moderate necromancy and transmutation; CL 7th; Slot: chest; Price: 12,000 gp, Weight: 15 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This armor is made from the scales of dire deadly king cobras. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor, but also gives the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Stealth and Intimidate checks and the ability to cast cause fear (caster level 7, Will DC 14) against one opponent within 10 ft, once per day, as a supernatural ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells cause fear, invisibility, silence; Cost: 6,000 gp.
